items.title: Jordan Poorman Cocker’s Vision of Global Indigeneity
items.summary: The curator, who just organized a major rehang of Indigenous art at Crystal Bridges, reflects on the ways institutions can create space for Native artists to flourish.

items.title: A View From the Easel: Natali Bravo-Barbee
items.summary: “As a mother, there are so many spaces in my life that are organized around other people’s needs. The studio is a space where I get to return to myself.”
